name: Demo block acceptance on Windows Bedrock

target.settings: Survival, normal difficulty, keyboard/mouse, experiments off; record resolution, graphics mode and GUI scale

requirements.expected: The disposable test world imports and opens with both demo packs active and no new pack-loading errors.
lab:test_block appears as a solid green emerald-textured cube on all six faces; no missing textures.
Placing the demo block through a real right-click consumes one item in Survival and puts lab:test_block at the aimed location.
The inventory shows the block with a readable Lab Test Block name and its icon; mouse selection and closing the menu work.
After saving, exiting and reopening the same disposable world, the placed block remains at its saved position.
